rows.text: An optimized Bracket 4 theft and lock deck led by Tergrid, God of Fright. Bracket 4 removes the Game Changer cap (running 15 Game Changers) and lifts the mass land denial ban, transforming Tergrid into an explosive stax-and-theft powerhouse. Fast mana powers Tergrid out on turn two or three, followed immediately by whole-table discard, symmetrical sacrifice, and hard locks like Contamination and Braids, Cabal Minion that prevent opponents from ever producing colored mana or maintaining permanents. Wins via stolen armies, Bloodchief Ascension + Mindcrank, or Bolas's Citadel storm.

rows.name: Tergrid, God of Fright
rows.text: Steals nontoken permanents opponents sacrifice and permanent cards they discard, including lands. Every edict and wheel becomes an overwhelming board-state swing in your favor.

cards.name: Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lantern

rows.name: Contamination
rows.text: Symmetrical lock that forces every land to produce {B} instead of any other type or amount. Tergrid constantly feeds its upkeep cost with stolen creatures, locking all non-black opponents completely out of colored mana.

rows.name: Braids, Cabal Minion
rows.text: Forces each player to sacrifice an artifact, creature, or land at upkeep. Tergrid steals each sacrificed permanent, fueling your board and feeding Braids's trigger on your own upkeep.

rows.name: Pox
rows.text: Each player loses a third of their life, discards a third of their hand, and sacrifices a third of their creatures and lands. With Tergrid on the board, it strips the table of resources and hands you a third of everyone's permanents.

rows.name: Smallpox
rows.text: Two-mana disruption that forces a discard, creature sacrifice, and land sacrifice. Steals up to nine permanents across three opponents on turn two or three.

rows.name: Dark Deal
rows.text: Forces each player to discard their hand and redraw minus one. Tergrid intercepts every permanent card discarded, yielding an instant army of ten to fifteen lands, rocks, and creatures.

rows.name: Mindslicer
rows.text: Death trigger empties all hands. Tergrid steals every permanent in opponents' hands while you untap with a full board.

rows.name: Opposition Agent
rows.text: Flashes in to control opponents while they search their libraries, exiling their best cards and shutting off fetchlands and tutors completely.

rows.name: Orcish Bowmasters
rows.text: Flashes in to punish draw steps, wheels, and cantrips, wiping out utility creatures while amassing an Orc army.

rows.name: Rankle's Prank
rows.text: Modular discard, sacrifice, and life loss that Tergrid turns into a massive multi-permanent theft swing.

rows.name: Rankle, Master of Pranks
rows.text: Repeatable combat trigger forcing discard, sacrifice, and draw on demand.

rows.name: Chrome Mox + Mox Diamond + Lotus Petal
rows.text: Zero-mana acceleration enabling turn-one or turn-two Tergrid deployments.

rows.name: Mana Vault + Grim Monolith
rows.text: Colorless burst mana that accelerates six-mana threats like Bolas's Citadel or casts Tergrid ahead of curve.

rows.name: Dark Ritual + Cabal Ritual + Culling the Weak
rows.text: Explosive black ritual mana. Culling converts a spent Virus Beetle or stolen token into four black mana.

rows.name: Ancient Tomb
rows.text: Two colorless mana on a land slot for fast development.

rows.name: Sol Ring + Arcane Signet + Jet Medallion
rows.text: Stable mana rocks that reduce casting costs and accelerate follow-up edicts.

rows.name: Cabal Coffers + Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth
rows.text: Generates exponential black mana to cast Torment of Hailfire or activate Tergrid's Lantern repeatedly.

rows.name: Phyrexian Tower
rows.text: Converts expendable or stolen creatures into two black mana.

rows.name: Demonic Tutor + Vampiric Tutor + Imperial Seal
rows.text: The premiere one- and two-mana tutors that assemble whatever lock piece or combo element is needed.

rows.name: Beseech the Mirror
rows.text: Four-mana tutor with bargain; sacrifice a stolen artifact or enchantment to tutor and cast Bolas's Citadel or Contamination directly.

rows.name: Diabolic Intent
rows.text: Two-mana tutor by sacrificing a creature, finding Dark Deal or a missing combo piece.

rows.name: Wishclaw Talisman
rows.text: Two-mana tutor to assemble the winning line on your turn.

rows.name: Bloodchief Ascension + Mindcrank
rows.text: Compact two-card infinite combo. With three quest counters on Ascension, any card put into an opponent's graveyard deals 2 damage and heals you for 2, which triggers Mindcrank to mill, repeating infinitely until all opponents are eliminated.

rows.name: Bolas's Citadel + Sensei's Divining Top + Aetherflux Reservoir
rows.text: Storm finish that draws your entire library by paying 1 life per Top activation and gaining compounding life off Reservoir, allowing you to cast your entire deck and blast the table.

rows.name: Necropotence
rows.text: Pay life to draw fifteen to twenty cards into hand, guaranteeing all fast mana, tutors, and protection are assembled.

rows.name: The One Ring
rows.text: Protection from everything for a full turn cycle while drawing an escalating stream of cards.

rows.name: Defense Grid
rows.text: Shuts down opposing countermagic and instant-speed interaction on your turn by taxing all off-turn spells by three generic mana.

rows.name: Imp's Mischief
rows.text: Deflects counterspells or targeted removal away from Tergrid or Bolas's Citadel.

rows.name: Deadly Rollick + Snuff Out
rows.text: Zero-mana instant removal to answer problematic hatebears without slowing your combo.

rows.name: Toxic Deluge + Blasphemous Edict
rows.text: Sweepers that reset the board if opponents develop faster than your edicts.

rows.name: Feed the Swarm + Withering Torment
rows.text: Targeted enchantment removal to destroy Rest in Peace, Leyline of the Void, or Stony Silence.

rows.name: Lightning Greaves
rows.text: Grants haste and shroud to protect Tergrid immediately upon entry.

rows.name: Kaya's Ghostform + Malakir Rebirth + Not Dead After All
rows.text: One-mana insurance that returns Tergrid if an opponent attempts to destroy or exile her.
Keep hands with fast mana (Dark Ritual, Chrome Mox, Sol Ring, Mana Vault) and at least one tutor or high-impact theft enabler. In Bracket 4, a slow hand without acceleration will be outpaced.
Deploy Tergrid early only if you have protection (Defense Grid, Imp's Mischief, Greaves, or Kaya's Ghostform) or an immediate follow-up spell (Dark Deal, Smallpox, Pox) on the same turn.

Against non-black decks, aggressively tutor for Contamination or Braids, Cabal Minion once Tergrid or a recurring creature (Bloodghast, Ophiomancer) is active. The mana lock is almost impossible for three opponents to break.
Use Urza's Saga to tutor Sensei's Divining Top (completing the Citadel combo) or Mana Vault / Sol Ring / Lotus Petal for acceleration.
